_backfill_note: Historical reconstruction on 2026-05-15. Tuesday — the single cleanest 'lead change' day of the AI race so far. THREE major events land in sequence: (1) Anthropic announces Claude Mythos Preview + Project Glasswing — Mythos scores 31pp higher than Opus 4.6 on USAMO 2026, autonomously identified+exploited thousands of unknown vulns including 27yr OpenBSD bug + 16yr FFmpeg flaw, 80%+ reproduction rate. 11 launch partners (AWS, Anthropic, Apple, Broadcom, Cisco, CrowdStrike, Google, JPMorganChase, Linux Foundation, Microsoft, NVIDIA, Palo Alto Networks) + 40+ critical-infrastructure orgs + $100M Mythos credits + $4M to open-source security orgs. First capability-gated frontier model. (2) Anthropic $30B ARR confirmed — overtakes OpenAI $25B for first time. Trajectory: $87M Jan-24 → $1B Dec-24 → $9B end-25 → $14B Feb-26 → $19B Mar-26 → $30B Apr-26. $1M+ enterprise customers doubled from ~500 (Feb) to 1,000+ (Apr). OpenAI disputes ~$8B overstatement on gross-rev basis. (3) Z.ai GLM-5.1 open-weight 744B MoE tops SWE-Bench Pro at 58.4 vs GPT-5.4 57.7 vs Opus 4.6 57.3 — MIT licensed, no commercial restrictions, demoed building Linux desktop from scratch over 655 iterations / ~8hr unattended. Cleanest 'Anthropic gates, China opens' framing of the year. Plus: Cloudflare fast-tracks post-quantum to 2029 — ML-DSA on origin by mid-2026, MTC end-user by mid-2027, SASE by early 2028; all free. Cisco joins Glasswing (sets up Galileo M&A Apr 9). Cybersecurity sector reaction same-day: Arctic Wolf 'turning point', Forrester '10 consequences', ASIS, CETaS. Research: Adam's Law textual frequency, TriAttention pre-RoPE KV compression, Memory Intelligence Agent Manager-Planner-Executor, Online Label Refinement RLVR, LightThinker++ memory management, ClawArena evolving environments, SkillX self-evolving skills on GLM-4.6, CIK attack taxonomy on personal agents. STAGE MOVES: glasswing-gated-release (new topic) spawns at score 30 = consolidating on day 1 (single-source-type-count under coverage gate so emerging actually). post-quantum-acceleration spawns at emerging. mythos-anthropic jumps to consolidating-high (fast EMA surges). lab-services-gtm gets large momentum from $30B ARR + 'Anthropic lead' framing. open-vs-closed gets GLM-5.1 anchor.
